title: 第15章 雷将听令第16章 雷来
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
林楠现在可以说是骑虎难下了。
如果只是大家起哄，林楠还可以拒绝，但现在已经被系统收录成建议了，就不得不想办法完成了。
只是他现在刚刚有了法力，而且还在扮演雷祖的过程中。
这时候如果施法求雨，岂不是真的要将雨水求来？不然这建议肯定是不作数的。
而且系统给的实在太多了。
足足百分之八的完成度奖励！
完成度达到5%时，他就已经获得了两个奖励了。
如果再加上这8%，总完成度会超过10%，达到13.6%。
这么高的完成度，又会获得什么厉害的奖励呢？
光是想想，林楠就已经觉得热血沸腾起来了。
于是在众人期待的注视下，他终于点头答应了大家的提议。
而他点头的同时，人群中也爆发出了一阵欢呼声。
“林楠，大方！”
“要怎么求雨啊？需要点什么？”
“是啊，需要什么就说，我们帮你找。”
同学们自然也是不当真的，只是单纯为了然闹。
直播间的网友们，更是礼物一个接着一个。
林楠借着夕阳的余晖，在操场上寻找着合适的位置。
王成宇一直在称职的跟拍林楠，见他四处张望，便小声的询问道：
“楠哥，你在找啥啊？大家都看着你呢，你咋还不开始呢？”

“是不是需要法器啊？”
“雌雄双鞭应该是落在宿舍里了，我让涛哥帮你去取？”
林楠也在此时找到了一处合适的好位置，风水比较有讲究，便点头道：
“行，不过不用取双鞭，把我桌子上那个陶瓷小罐子，还有架子上的毛笔拿来就行。”
“好。”
有了林楠的话，姜涛跟张勇说了声，便快速的跑着回去取东西了。
而林楠也走到了刚刚发现的那处好位置上。
此时三班的众人，也跟随着他来到了此处，并且身后还跟着闻讯而来的其他班的同学们。
整个操场以林楠为中心，围了一个大大的圈。
“那个穿着扮演服的人是叫林楠吗？他长得真是太有神明威严那味儿了。”
“是啊，他现在已经在抖音扮演区火了。
据说是扮演区唯一一个扮神的主播，并且还有很多网友主动给他出谋划策，送礼物让他扮演呢。”
“我听说信神的那些人，对于亵渎神灵的行为可是很厌恶的，他竟然没被网友喷，也是很神奇了。”
“是啊，确实没看到这样的人。”
“姜涛回来了！”
看到姜涛拿着东西回来，大家纷纷让开了路，但是嘴里的议论却没有停止。
content_en:
Lin Nan can be said to be riding a tiger now.
If everyone was just making noise, Lin Nan could still refuse, but now that it has been included as a suggestion by the system, he has to find a way to complete it.
It's just that he has just gained mana and is still in the process of playing Lei Zu.
If you cast a spell to pray for rain at this time, wouldn’t you really be asking for rain? Otherwise, this suggestion will definitely not count.
And the system gives too much.
A full eight percent completion reward!
When the completion rate reached 5%, he had already received two rewards.
If you add this 8%, the total completion rate will exceed 10%, reaching 13.6%.
What great rewards will you get for such a high degree of completion?
Just thinking about it made Lin Nan's blood boil.
So under everyone's expectant gaze, he finally nodded and agreed to everyone's proposal.
While he nodded, the crowd also burst into cheers.
"Lin Nan, be generous!"
"How can I ask for rain? Do you need anything?"
"Yeah, just tell us what you need and we'll find it for you."
Naturally, the students didn't take it seriously, they were just making trouble for fun.
Netizens in the live broadcast room gave gifts one after another.
Lin Nan took advantage of the afterglow of the setting sun to find a suitable position on the playground.
Wang Chengyu had been following Lin Nan competently, and when he saw him looking around, he asked in a low voice:
"Brother Nan, what are you looking for? Everyone is looking at you, why don't you start?"
"Do you need a magic weapon?"
"The male and female whips should have been left in the dormitory. Should I ask Brother Tao to pick them up for you?"
Lin Nan also found a suitable and good location at this time. The feng shui is quite particular, so he nodded and said:
"Okay, but you don't need to get the double whips. Just get the small ceramic jar on my table and the brushes on the shelf."
"Okay."
With Lin Nan's words, Jiang Tao spoke to Zhang Yong and quickly ran back to get the things.
And Lin Nan also walked to the good location he just discovered.
At this time, everyone from Class 3 also followed him here, and behind him were students from other classes who came after hearing the news.
The entire playground formed a big circle with Lin Nan as the center.
"Is the man in the costume named Lin Nan? He looks so majestic and divine."
“Yes, he is now popular in the Douyin play section.
It is said that he is the only anchor in the acting area who plays god, and many netizens take the initiative to give him advice and gifts for him to act. "
"I heard that people who believe in God are very disgusted by blasphemous behavior. It's amazing that he didn't get trolled by netizens."
"Yeah, I really haven't seen such a person."
"Jiang Tao is back!"
Seeing Jiang Tao coming back with something, everyone got out of the way, but the discussion did not stop.
